name: Playhead
notes:
**Phones and tablets**
- Back goes back through pages; only Discover closes the app.
- The player is truly fullscreen: no clock or battery bar.
- New Fit/Fill button to fill tall screens (W on a keyboard).

**Player**
- A dark loading screen while the video starts, which fades into playback.
- Leaving the player saves your progress immediately, so Continue Watching is up to date.
- Downloads play in Playhead's own player.

**Finding sources**
- Much smarter title matching, Sonarr/Radarr-style. Oddly formatted release names (spaced-out letters, dots, years, "Part 1") are no longer filtered out, while genuinely different titles still are.

**TV navigation**
- Arrows stop at the edges of the sidebar and the Settings list instead of jumping somewhere random.
- Long text-only sections can be scrolled through with Up/Down.
- One smooth scroll per press, no double movement.
- Activity now shows only History and Downloads.

Windows stays on build 6 for this test release.
